paragraphs: (Elyakim son of King Josiah. Hyman cites II Kings 24:34. The passage is at [II Kings 23:34](https://www.sefaria.org/II_Kings.23.34).) Rabbi Yose ben Elyakim, [Berakhot 9b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.9b.16). Rabbi Shimon ben Elyakim, [Ketubot 50b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.50b.9).[^1]

notes.text: Pharaoh Necho renamed Elyakim son of Josiah Yehoyakim. The rabbinic references are separately discussed in Heilprin’s entries for [Rabbi Yose ben Elyakim](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1941&lang=en) and [Rabbi Shimon ben Elyakim](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3463&lang=en).
